contradicting_evidence: BTC and ETH have positive hourly and 24h returns, and ETH/BTC improved in the latest completed hour.
BTC spot buying is supportive, while positive breadth and selective smaller-asset strength leave room for a broader relief rally.
Stablecoin supply was slightly positive over one day, so the slower contraction is not evidence of uninterrupted daily withdrawal.
The settled ETF figures describe the November 20 session and are unchanged from the prior packet; they are not fresh intraday outflows.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A low-confidence downside bias favors renewed pressure on rebound attempts over a durable broad recovery. Intermittent BTC/ETH strength can coexist with this path. Stabilization or apparent absorption would not, by itself, overturn the downside assessment.
falsification_conditions: Sustained price follow-through accompanied by improving spot demand and durable ETH/BTC strength would weaken the downside bias.
Source-qualified breadth expansion with stronger large- and mid-alt participation would contradict the present weak-transmission assessment.
Improving subsequent settled ETF flows and stabilization of the stablecoin supply trend would undermine the liquidity-pressure thesis.
missing_evidence: New settled ETF sessions to determine whether the latest negative session persists or reverses.
Repeated breadth observations and independent confirmation of broad participation.
Evidence that stablecoin supply is being deployed into risk assets.
Fresh macro observations; the supplied yields and VIX are slow context, not evidence of an ongoing intraday shock.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply declined 1.584% over seven days and 6.166% over thirty days, providing a liquidity headwind despite the small positive one-day change.
The latest final ETF session recorded BTC outflows of $124.5 million and ETH outflows of $13.2 million, offering no institutional-flow confirmation of recovery.
The selected breadth observation is 59%, down 21 percentage points versus the prior packet. Only 42 of 100 constituents outperformed BTC and 36 outperformed ETH.
Large- and mid-alt proxy advance ratios are only about 53% and 52%; large-alt median performance trails BTC. Stronger Top-100 tail performance does not establish broad transmission.
The supplied 10-year yield of 5.04% and VIX of 28.44 describe a challenging risk backdrop, although their levels do not establish a new deterioration.
The freshest breadth point is used once. The aggregate and capitalization buckets share an upstream family and are not independent confirming votes.
